children: Overview
UK loyalty platform's FY26 revenue excluding NRS grew 21% yr/yr
Annual recurring revenue rose 31% yr/yr, driven by new customer wins and deeper relationships
Adjusted EBITDA fell 19% yr/yr, reflecting investment and operational changes
Outlook
Company expects a return to double-digit revenue and adjusted EBITDA growth in FY27
Eagle Eye maintains medium-term ambitions of £100 mln revenue and adjusted EBITDA margin above 30%
Company expects OEM partnership to become a significant growth contributor from FY27, with revenue from new contracts in 2027
Result Drivers
AI-POWERED PLATFORM ADOPTION - Co said increased customer adoption and usage of its AI-powered loyalty and promotions platform drove 35% growth in EagleAI revenues and contributed to ARR gains
COMMERCIAL MOMENTUM - Co attributed results to 13 major customer wins, including expansion in North America and new sectors such as airlines and quick service restaurants
OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCIES - Co said platform optimisation and internal use of AI tools led to faster deployments and recurring cloud cost savings, supporting margin improvement
